title: Jeremy Chapple
intro: I'm Jeremy, a customer experience strategist, facilitator and systems thinker.
byline: I work at the intersection of systems, students, and software at [🎓 QUT](https://www.qut.edu.au), steering digital products and coaching emerging UX talent. Along the way, I built our internal research engine from zero and proved that good design is just cheap insurance on expensive capital investments.
